title: [Look L1 · Visual] Swappable branded visual Looks independent of component structure
body:
Parent: #5354. Canonical Look contract: #5368 (multimodal Look); structural boundary #5364; checked component Fores #5365; accessibility certification #5367. Related #5361 model-facing Look style and #5370 spoken Look. Reuse accepted `ApplicationTheme`/Phosphor foundation #683, #2873, #3164, #3397, and `docs/architecture/patchbay-theme.md`; don't restart closed work.

## Outcome
Make **look**, not *theme*, the app/user-selectable, swappable, typed expression policy. This ticket implements specifically its **visual facet**, so it can be combined with the spoken and LLM facets of the **same Look** without requiring those media on every Host. A Look chooses how a checked component/Face encounter appears, never which meaningful components, subjects, actions or affordances exist.

## Four independent responsibilities
1. **Face:** authoritative names, states, relationships, typed values, action identity/contract, availability and meaning.
2. **Component:** ordinary Plot with a checked Fore and a bounded structural recipe. It owns grouping/slots, structural composition, responsive variants, visible/accessible traversal and layout constraints.
3. **Look (this ticket):** color, typography choices, type scale, stroke, radius, materials, icon/decorative art treatment, motion, appearance-only tokens and finite brand assets.
4. **Mask Host:** actual admitted renderer, fonts/assets, capabilities and accessibility/user constraints; it selects an honest Back and acknowledges actual Show.

## One-time migration into canonical Looks
`semantics/presentation/src/application_theme.rs::ApplicationTheme` is a **legacy implementation/wire name**, currently bundling RGB colors, text/spacing metrics and even `responsive_breakpoint_px` / `responsive_grid_min_px`. Migrate the existing `conduit.presentation/phosphor@1` assets to canonical typed Look facets in a bounded reviewed change, rather than maintaining an old-wire reader, while moving responsive **variant selection and grid structure** into the component/Mask layout policy (contracts #5364/#5365). Theme typography/spacing values still trigger legitimate text measurement and bounded reflow under an unchanged structural contract. Historical `ThemePack`, `ApplicationTheme` and 'theme' appear only in migration documentation; obsolete runtime APIs and old wire identities refuse.

## Scope
- Define a finite versioned/digest-addressed `Look` visual facet with typed appearance tokens, scoping, selected style hooks and exactly bounded evaluation. Different components consume the same semantic token roles but need not share geometrical structure. Appearance tokens are separate from source Face/content identity.
- Allow a developer-supplied Look to brand multiple applications and an independently authored component to be rendered with multiple Looks. A selected Look may have optional `spoken` / `generative` facets (spec #5368); do not collapse voice pitch, waveform, layout pixel metrics and LLM prompting into one untyped bag.
- Theme/Look inheritance or cascade, if implemented, is a **finite typed value precedence**, not arbitrary selectors or CSS structural mutations; no `display:none` of mandatory content, `pointer-events` override, action rewriting, source-text replacement, focus-order mutation or role/ARIA injection.
- Enforce accessibility/user hard constraints above app Look: contrast, forced colors, high zoom/large type, reduced motion and visible keyboard focus. A brand pack unable to comply must refuse/fallback and cannot make required affordances disappear or overlap.
- A browser Mask may lower visual facet to scoped CSS variables and admitted assets; native ConduitOS maps it to finite graphics roles and prepared resources. Actual font/icon/image availability is Host truth, not a Look assertion.
- Distinguish appearance-only changes from newly admitted resource requirements. New Look can change Show (and if necessary selected Mask Plan) but **never changes Body/Face/action identity or privileges**. No silent runtime allocation or unbounded downloads.

## Acceptance
- [ ] Same exact Face and **same checked component Fore/recipe** rendered with migrated Phosphor Look and one materially different Look; paint/typography change while semantic content, action targets, meaningful traversal and accessibility semantics remain unchanged.
- [ ] The same visual Look works on both a Todo action row and a Patchbay node with **different structures**, rather than forcing shared markup or a card widget.
- [ ] Two separate implementations (native/browser where supported) consume the same visual Look identity and express consistent intent without pretending pixels must match.
- [ ] A Look with absent visual facet yields a deterministic, usable default rendering; absent font/asset or unsupported Host style produces truthful resource refusal/fallback without losing actions.
- [ ] A Look cannot encode or alter focus/role/ARIA, action, domain state, layout variant, mandatory disclosure, control binding ("Fire"), source wording or accessible names.
- [ ] Color-only status, decorative occlusion, low contrast, narrow viewport, font metric reflow, large labels, high zoom, reduced motion and forced colors are covered by negative/conformance tests.
- [ ] Migrated Phosphor/Product rendering runs only through canonical typed Look; obsolete theme wire refuses after migration, verified through native/browser computed styles, screenshot/identity proof and required lint/tests.
- [ ] Verify the same named Look can later include a spoken facet without requiring this visual implementation to become a speech engine.

## Ownership and order
Visual Look data and one-time migration: `semantics/presentation/src/application_theme.rs` and focused new Look modules as warranted; browsers: scoped CSS token mapping; native: display/typography/theme token translators. F3 #5357 owns deterministic **structural layout**, C1 #5365 owns component Fores, S1 #5370 owns spoken Look. Coordinate these overlapping files, hand off explicitly.

## Stop line
No new universal Face 'theme' properties, global widget/DOM hierarchy, raw CSS/JS escape hatch claiming certified semantics, unbounded asset loading, ad hoc voice generator, or dependency of first playable Commons #5360 on arbitrary look support.

## First vertical: compact and spacious Todo Looks (2026-10-09)
**Prioritize density, not simply dark/light palette.** From the same checked Todo Face and **same component structure**, add two named Looks: `compact` uses tighter spacing and type rhythm for information-dense display; `spacious` uses generous touch targets, breathing room and comfortable typography. Both preserve the exact item/verb/action identity, meaningful order, required content, keyboard focus and pointer accessibility. Colors may remain Phosphor in both; dark and light palettes are orthogonal optional Look variations.

In browser Mask, lower the bounded density tokens to scoped CSS custom properties and current styles. Allow density to trigger responsive reflow/wrapping **inside the checked component's allowed layout envelope**, but don't permit `display:none` of required items, semantic reorder, role/ARIA injection, or changing from one component topology to another. Use existing rendering entry, not a new Todo-only DOM or CSS framework. In ConduitOS native Mask, adopt equivalent density intent through admitted graphics/text metrics when available; browser parity is not QEMU proof.

Acceptance: (a) actual interactive Todo browser screenshots at 2 widths and both Looks; (b) same committed Body/Face/action/Show-correlation through a switch without rebirth or mutation; (c) long Unicode labels, zoom, narrow viewport and large-text accessibility under both; (d) a third palette axis can change independently without demanding a different structural component; (e) full usable deterministic fallback for missing Look. #5370 separately tests brief/expanded spoken templates with the same Face.

## Browser CSS implementation and syntax split
Visual Look density/spacing/typographic choice is the **first** demonstration, not automatically a new structure; compact and spacious share the exact component, semantic slot order and typed action contracts. The detailed **real CSS** admission, scoped style hooks, Grid/Flex/reflow and runtime accessibility correspondence belong to #5379. Its checked `.conduit` authoring and CSS literal/reference spelling belong to #5377; its actual Web Component Back belongs to #5376. This issue owns renderer-independent visual Look tokens and one-time Phosphor migration (#5627), moving old responsive fields to checked Mask layout constraints. Browser/native mapping uses canonical Looks, not an old-wire adapter. A CSS-satisfied browser test cannot be relabeled native QEMU graphical proof. One density/palette axis can change independently of spoken verbosity (#5380).

---

## Thin delivery slices (2026-10-13)
- [ ] **V1** #5627: Migrate ApplicationTheme/Phosphor into canonical typed Look facets
- [ ] **V2** #5628: Select two actual visual Looks on one reusable component

Contract #5368, separation #5364, component #5365. CSS browser implementation #5379 is separate.

Queued, not automatically active; coordinate Look/Mask files under #5520 WIP limit.


### Second-pass independent behavior split of #5629 (2026-10-13)
- [ ] #5629: [VisualLook V3] Prove visual Looks preserve focus, reading order and accessibility

Proof classes and existing source contracts remain exact. WIP #5520; don't open multiple implementation PRs at once.

---

## Native typographic ensemble and coordinated UX route (2026-10-18)

- [ ] **Native typography** #5992: bounded serif/sans/mono repertoire under source-neutral selected visual Look, pinned assets/licenses/hashes, Unicode/fallback, measured text and actual ConduitOS QEMU evidence. This enhances accepted #3163 and must not introduce a runtime font loader or source-authored family names.
- [ ] **Coordinated serial native acceptance** #5994: one agent's ordered source-action → Crèche controls → structural layout → canonical Look → font resources → two Looks → fallback/QEMU → Patchbay path.

Coordinate #5627 typed migration, #5628 actual Look selection and #5629 Look/focus/accessibility acceptance. Typeface choice is Look/Host realization; Face has the same semantics under editorial and engineering Looks. No independent framework and no premature closure of visual Look parent.
